Overview

Bristol is a city in England with a population of 472,465. A creative coastal city with a thriving aerospace and tech sector, vibrant street art, and excellent quality of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
